device.name: RoboPianist: two Shadow Hands at a simulated piano

facts.text: load(environment_name, midi_file=None, seed=None, stretch=1.0, shift=0, recompile_physics=False, legacy_step=True, task_kwargs=None) is the suite's environment factory.
load reads a midi_file when one is given and otherwise refuses a name outside ALL with a ValueError.
load returns composer_utils.Environment with a PianoWithShadowHands task, random_state=seed, strip_singleton_obs_buffer_dim=True, recompile_physics and legacy_step.
The suite imports composer from dm_control and composer_utils from mujoco_utils.
The core requirements include dm_control, dm_env_wrappers, mujoco and mujoco_utils.
The debug environments are named RoboPianist-debug-<name>-v0 after the pieces of music.DEBUG_MIDIS.
The debug MIDI library maps eight piece names, TwinkleTwinkleLittleStar among them, to functions that build the pieces.
The PIG repertoire pieces are read from robopianist/music/data/pig_single_finger/*.proto.
The suite quickstart loads RoboPianist-debug-TwinkleTwinkleLittleStar-v0, reads action_spec(), and calls env.reset() and env.step(action) until timestep.last().
Importing robopianist raises FileNotFoundError when neither SalamanderGrandPiano.sf2 nor the default TimGM6mb.sf2 soundfont exists.
The import first reads ~/.robopianistrc, when it exists, for a DEFAULT_SOUNDFONT.
install_deps.sh downloads TimGM6mb.sf2 from SourceForge and copies the soundfonts into robopianist/soundfonts.
install_deps.sh checks the menagerie submodule out at 1afc8be64233dcfe943b2fe0c505ec1e87a0a13e and copies its shadow_hand directory to robopianist/models/hands/third_party/shadow_hand.
The repository declares third_party/mujoco_menagerie as a git submodule.
The README says the MuJoCo Menagerie has its own licence and the rest of the code is Apache-2.0.
The Shadow Hand XML files are read from robopianist/models/hands/third_party/shadow_hand.
The physics timestep is 0.005 s and the control timestep 0.05 s (20 Hz).
The right hand starts at (0.4, 0.15, 0.13) and the left hand at (0.4, -0.15, 0.13).
The task's action spec is the right hand's spec, then the left hand's, then a sustain spec from 0.0 to 1.0.
before_step gives the first and second halves of all but the last action element to the right and left hands and the last element to the sustain pedal.
A hand's action spec is created from its actuators by mujoco_utils' spec_utils.create_action_spec.
forearm_tx has a dummy range that the task sets at initialization, and forearm_ty ranges from 0.0 to 0.06.
The default forearm degrees of freedom are forearm_tx and forearm_ty.
The ShadowHand constructor adds the forearm degrees of freedom before it collects the joints and actuators.
Each forearm degree of freedom adds a position actuator whose ctrlrange is its joint range.
The forearm_tx range is the piano's half width either side, offset by the hand's y position.
The task overrides the forearm_tx joint range and actuator ctrlrange with that range.
The piano's size is the size of its base body's geom.
The piano base is a box geom of size BASE_SIZE.
BASE_SIZE is half of the base's length, width and height, and the base width is PIANO_LENGTH.
PIANO_LENGTH is 52 white keys of 0.0225 m plus 51 spaces of 0.001 m.

The right Shadow Hand's position actuator classes set ctrlrange: wrist_y -0.523599 to 0.174533, wrist_x -0.698132 to 0.488692, thbase -1.0472 to 1.0472, thproximal 0 to 1.22173, thhub -0.20944 to 0.20944, thmiddle -0.698132 to 0.698132, thdistal -0.261799 to 1.5708, metacarpal 0 to 0.785398, knuckle -0.349066 to 0.349066, proximal -0.261799 to 1.5708 and middle_distal 0 to 3.1415.
The right hand has 20 position actuators: wrist (2), thumb (5), first, middle and ring finger (3 each, the last on a tendon) and little finger (4).
The left Shadow Hand's position actuator classes set the same ctrlranges.
The left hand's 20 position actuators follow the same order and classes.
The goal observation holds the keys and sustain of the current frame and the next n_steps_lookahead frames.
The default n_steps_lookahead is 1 and wrong_press_termination is False.
The enabled observables are the hands' joint positions, the piano's key and sustain state, the goal and, when the piece has fingering, the fingering.
after_step marks the episode to end at the last note frame.
Each episode starts with discount 1.0.
get_discount returns the task's discount, and should_terminate_episode ends the episode at the last frame, or on a wrong key press when wrong_press_termination is set, with discount 0.0.
The reward adds key press, sustain and energy terms, a fingering term (an optimal-transport fingering term when the piece has none) and a forearm term.
Without fingering, the task constructor prints a line to standard output.
The package version is 1.0.10.

determinism.notes: A dm_env reset takes no seed: the live environment is seeded once, when it is built (random_state=seed, robopianist/suite/__init__.py:87-93); no seeded determinism is claimed for MuJoCo or for the fake.

fidelity.engine: analytic: dm_env stand-in for robopianist.suite.load (no MuJoCo, dm_control, MIDI or sound)
gaps: the fake is an analytic stand-in with no physics, piano, hands, MIDI or sound; it keeps only the dm_env calls the SDK's adapter makes (reset, step, action_spec, observation_spec, control_timestep, close)

its action spec copies the shape and per-element bounds of the default task (45 values: 22 per hand, then the sustain pedal), each cited in the facts; the order and dtype of a hand's elements in the live spec are those of mujoco_utils.spec_utils.create_action_spec, a library outside the clone (robopianist/models/hands/shadow_hand.py:372-378)

its observation is only the goal vector (178 values, all placeholders); the live observation also has the hands' joint positions, the piano's key and sustain state and, when the MIDI has fingering, the fingering (robopianist/suite/tasks/piano_with_shadow_hands.py:414-449)
its episode lasts 8 control steps and every reward is 0.0 (placeholders); the live episode lasts as many control steps as the MIDI piece has frames

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: Software latch over a synchronous simulator: the dm_control composer world integrates physics only inside a native step or reset, so after an e-stop no step or reset is dispatched until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and a native step already running completes (the e-stop waits for it within its budget) before the e-stop confirms. There is nothing physical: two simulated Shadow Hands and a simulated piano.
